influences.name: Miles Davis
influences.context: Miles Davis was the best teacher, always amused when I asked him questions. I was pretty cocky at the time, and I once asked him why he played so many bad notes, unlike Bix Beiderbecke and Louis Armstrong, who always played clean. He didn't blink. He didn't bite my head off. "Because I try and play what I hear in my head," he said, "not what I know I can already play." That, to me, was the essence of jazz, trying to get somewhere new and not worrying if you made mistakes as long as you got there in the end.
